sources.name: KeenGamer: Best Class for Every Character
AllThings.How: Class Guide, All Tiers and Masteries
sources.covers: Tier names, unlocks and the tip notes

roles.name: Healer
roles.summary: Strongest healing, with an edge against enemy mages.

roles.name: Attack mage
roles.summary: Offensive magic with better accuracy and bind resistance.

roles.name: Mounted mage
roles.summary: Keeps offensive magic while gaining movement.

roles.name: Swordfighter
roles.summary: Fast sword damage and critical hits to finish fights.

roles.name: Axe bruiser
roles.summary: Strength-driven close combat with a heavy finisher.

roles.name: Archer
roles.summary: Reliable long-range damage and the anti-flier role.

roles.name: Mounted archer
roles.summary: Moves and shoots from new angles across big maps.

roles.name: Armored wall
roles.summary: Holds chokepoints, shields allies and counterattacks.

roles.name: Cavalry
roles.summary: Mounted frontliners with mobility and durability.

roles.name: Flier
roles.summary: Flies over terrain to reach targets others can't.

roles.name: Frontline support
roles.summary: Spear fighter on foot who can also heal nearby allies.

roles.name: Brawler-healer
roles.summary: Fights up close on one turn and heals on the next.

roles.name: Thief and utility
roles.summary: Combat plus locks, chests and exploration.

roles.name: Unique paths
roles.summary: Characters with their own route or special class.

characters.name: Alexandra
characters.why: Mobile flier with improved survivability and reach.

characters.name: Anatolia
characters.why: Contributes on both offense and support turns.

characters.name: Aswan
characters.why: Joins in Part III, when retraining costs more than it returns.

characters.name: Benditz
characters.why: Mounted ranged attacker who covers large areas.

characters.name: Bertrand
characters.why: Simple physical package with a heavy finisher.

characters.name: Bonaventure
characters.why: Mobile magic attacker.

characters.name: Buccar
characters.why: Front-line durability and ally shielding.

characters.name: Cai
characters.why: Stays mounted and turns spear skill into mobile offense.

characters.name: Catania
characters.why: Speed and precision for finishing kills.

characters.name: Centurio
characters.why: Absorbs enemy turns and hits back hard.

characters.name: Creek
characters.why: Defensive mounted unit that keeps pace on large maps.

characters.name: Dadao
characters.why: Turns Strength into heavy-hitting damage.

characters.name: Dante
characters.why: Strongest offensive magic route.

characters.name: Diego
characters.why: Combat plus lockpicking and searching.

characters.name: Dietrich
characters.why: Sword critical-hit build. The Blade is his Divine class.
characters.tip: AllThings.How also suggests In Shadow (Rogue) for his evasion, Ever Vigilant (Shido) for his crits, and Overtake (Caladrius) as a mobile finisher.

characters.name: Esmeralda
characters.why: Chokepoint defender who protects nearby allies.

characters.name: Eshmel
characters.why: Spear pressure, healing and staying power in a lane.

characters.name: Fabio
characters.why: Offensive magic without spending ranks on other weapons.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests Ever Vigilant (Shido) to pair his Death spell with crit-focused units.

characters.name: Fianna
characters.why: Strongest healer route, with a defensive edge against mages.

characters.name: Gaitz
characters.why: Maximizes sword offense and finishing burst.

characters.name: Goliath
characters.why: Physical wall that protects allies and counterattacks.

characters.name: Guzran
characters.why: Flexible combat plus exploration utility.

characters.name: Halvin
characters.why: Reliable long-range damage and anti-flier role.

characters.name: Hong Hua
characters.why: Pure offensive magic with high-impact spells.

characters.name: Inyoni
characters.why: Maximizes ranged pressure and anti-flier damage.

characters.name: Io
characters.why: Durable frontliner with mounted mobility.

characters.name: Jasmine
characters.why: Counter-focused defense that protects allies.

characters.name: Jester
characters.why: Fits his fast sword style without splitting training.

characters.name: Kiroc
characters.why: Flanks exposed targets and handles doors and chests.

characters.name: Klapka
characters.why: Joins in Part III. Keep his class unless a direct upgrade is available.

characters.name: Leda
characters.why: Stay a Dancer most of the game. The Apsara is her Divine class for a support slot.

characters.name: Lillian
characters.why: Highly accurate ranged damage and anti-flier role.

characters.name: Loretta
characters.why: Concentrates training on swords for immediate damage.

characters.name: Ludia
characters.why: Fast follow-up attacks that end fights quickly.

characters.name: Lysander
characters.why: Fast, aggressive spear cavalry.

characters.name: Majide
characters.why: Axes match his Strength, with a boss-damage option.

characters.name: Mikaela
characters.why: Efficient axe build with a strong finisher.

characters.name: Mu
characters.why: Simple, high-output physical role with burst options.

characters.name: Nathan
characters.why: Brings physical pressure with mobility and durability.

characters.name: Nezha
characters.why: Rewards attacking first and ending fights quickly.

characters.name: Ninae
characters.why: Pure support with strong healing and anti-mage value.

characters.name: Noctula
characters.why: Straightforward brawler with a heavy finisher.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests In Shadow (Rogue) because Noctula dodges well.

characters.name: Nuzzuo
characters.why: Exploits weak points and covers exploration.

characters.name: Nydine
characters.why: Survivability through flying mobility.

characters.name: Olympia
characters.why: Dedicated healer with stronger recovery.

characters.name: Orchel
characters.why: Strength-driven close combat with high finishing power.

characters.name: Peppe
characters.why: Mobile archer who keeps changing firing angles.

characters.name: Peter
characters.why: Dedicated archer with reliable long-range hits.

characters.name: Seteth
characters.why: Aggressive flier that bypasses most terrain.

characters.name: Sha Lan
characters.why: Maximizes her value as a healer.

characters.name: Simon
characters.why: Direct physical pressure with a finisher for tough enemies.

characters.name: Sirocco
characters.why: Keeps offensive magic while gaining mobility.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests In Shadow (Rogue) for his evasion and Ever Vigilant (Shido) for his crits.

characters.name: Sofia
characters.why: Maximizes healing output.

characters.name: Tahonia
characters.why: Joins in Part III, too late to start a new weapon path.

characters.name: Talimun
characters.why: Uses his existing sword training for kill potential.

characters.name: Theodora
characters.why: Balanced durability, damage and support on foot.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests Crescendo (Archer) to shore up her accuracy. The Trident Divine class doesn't stack well with her Mahado's Right Arm.

characters.name: Tialla
characters.why: Support healer with strong recovery and anti-caster value.

characters.name: Tobias
characters.why: Close-range Strength with an answer to bulky targets.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests Crescendo (Archer) to make up for his low accuracy.

characters.name: Troy
characters.why: Combines brawling offense with healing.

characters.name: Ultand
characters.why: Front-line fighter who can also heal nearby allies.

characters.name: Ursula
characters.why: Strong bow damage and anti-flier role. Shadow Seeker only for utility.

characters.name: Yang Jie
characters.why: Covers both melee combat and healing.

characters.name: Zarcone
characters.why: Endgame class for an axe specialist.
